title: solidago virgaurea var. litoralis
intro: Solidago virgaurea var. litoralis, commonly known as Coastal Goldenrod, is a plant species that is a variant of the Solidago virgaurea, a flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, that may help to alleviate symptoms of digestive issues, respiratory problems, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Coastal Goldenrod are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which interact with the body's systems to produce its medicinal effects. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to support liver health, reduce fever, and promote wound healing.
